mapper.select: select * from libary.books where bookname like #{bookname};
mapper.insert: insert into libary.borrow_records (bookid, username, borrow_date, due_date, status) values (#{bookid}, #{username}, now(), DATE_ADD(now(), INTERVAL 30 DAY), 0);
insert into libary.reservations (bookid, username, reserve_date) values (#{bookid}, #{username}, now());
mapper.select: select id, bookid, username, borrow_date, due_date, return_date, status from libary.borrow_records order by borrow_date desc
select count(*) from libary.borrow_records where status = 0
select count(*) from libary.borrow_records where status = 0 and due_date < now()
